title: Parallel Thinking for Large Language Model with Path Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2610.29501v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel thinking has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously. However, we identify that parallel thinking via Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically suffers from the mode collapse of reasoning paths, where parallel thinking trajectories degenerate into similar ones. This homogeneity undermines the fundamental motivation of parallel thinking, that is, maintaining multiple hypotheses concurrently to prevent premature loss into a suboptimal solution. In this paper, we propose Diverse Parallel Thinking (DPT), a simple yet effective RL approach for parallel thinking designed to encourage path diversity. DPT rewards the model to develop distinct reasoning strategies by penalizing the prefix similarity of parallel thinking paths, thereby enhancing a more comprehensive exploration of the reasoning space. translated_title: 基于路径多样性的大语言模型并行思考
translated_abstract: 并行思考已成为通过同时探索多条推理路径来增强大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的一种有前景的范式。然而，我们发现基于强化学习（RL）的并行思考通常存在推理路径的模式坍塌问题，即并行思考轨迹会退化为相似的路径。这种同质性破坏了并行思考的根本动机，即同时保持多个假设以防止过早陷入次优解。在本文中，我们提出了多样性并行思考，这是一种简单而有效的、旨在鼓励路径多样性的并行思考强化学习方法。DPT通过惩罚并行思考路径的前缀相似性来奖励模型发展不同的推理策略，从而实现对推理空间的更全面探索。我们进行了多种实验验证……
tldr: 提出DPT方法，通过惩罚并行思考路径的前缀相似性来鼓励路径多样性，从而解决强化学习并行思考中推理路径模式坍塌的问题，实现对推理空间更全面的探索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Diverse Parallel Thinking (DPT), a simple yet effective RL approach that penalizes prefix similarity of parallel reasoning paths to encourage path diversity, addressing the mode collapse problem in RL-based parallel thinking and enabling more comprehensive exploration of the reasoning space.
